scientific_integrity: The Chebyshev determinant, Fourier singular-value, and Diophantine asymptotic arguments are explicit. Finite tests corroborate algebra but are not treated as a proof of infinite-dimensional quantifiers. Historical priority is qualified and independent validation has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns exact-arithmetic 1D three-tap two-phase circular stencils with fixed parameters. It does not assert failure of regularized inversion, random parameter choices, or floating-point implementations. High-order Liouville effects can change under finite-precision coefficient rounding.
title: Arithmetic conditioning of a two-periodic stochastic circular blur
